name: browser-use
headline: Gemini-MCP - Connects Claude Code with Gemini
short_description: Gemini-MCP enables Claude Code to interact with Google's Gemini models. Operations teams can automate workflows by connecting these AI systems. It integrates with TypeScript-based tools and supports CLI for easy management.
author: RLabs-Inc

sections.overview:
Gemini-MCP is an MCP server that bridges Google's Gemini 3 models with Claude Code, enabling seamless collaboration between AI systems. It provides 20+ tools including deep research with web search, image generation up to 4K, video creation, document and code analysis, real-time web search with citations, and Python code execution. The skill supports token counting for cost estimation, context caching for efficient queries, multi-turn image editing, YouTube analysis, and structured JSON outputs with schema validation. Teams can install it globally as a CLI or integrate it directly into Claude Code to automate research workflows, generate content, analyze data, and solve complex problems through coordinated AI reasoning.
Automate multi-step research workflows with web search and citations
Generate and iteratively edit images and videos for content creation
Analyze documents, PDFs, code, and web pages for insights and quality issues
Execute Python data analysis and visualization tasks with Gemini
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/RLabs-Inc/gemini-mcp`
sections.usage:
```
Use the gemini-mcp tool to [TASK]. Execute the following steps: 1) Connect to the Gemini model via gemini-mcp, 2) Provide the required inputs or context, 3) Process the output to [SPECIFIC_ACTION]. Example: 'Use gemini-mcp to analyze the latest server logs in /var/log/app.log. Identify any critical errors, their frequency, and suggest remediation steps. Format the output as a markdown report with sections for errors, root causes, and action items.'
```
Copy

```
